trials.title: A Phase 1/2, Open-Label, Randomized, Dose Finding and Dose Expansion Study of Gedatolisib in Combination With Darolutamide in Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)
trials.briefTitle: Gedatolisib in Combination With Darolutamide in Metastatic Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer

arms.label: Phase 1 Arm 1
arms.description: Arm 1 - 120 mg of gedatolisib (administered once weekly for 3 weeks on/1 week off) in combination with darolutamide 600 mg (two 300 mg tablets) orally administered twice daily (equivalent to a total daily dose of 1200 mg on Days 1-28 of each cycle)

arms.label: Phase 1 Arm 2
arms.description: Arm 2 - 180 mg of gedatolisib (administered once weekly for 3 weeks on/1 week off) in combination with darolutamide 600 mg (two 300 mg tablets) orally administered twice daily (equivalent to a total daily dose of 1200 mg on Days 1-28 of each cycle)

arms.label: Phase 2
arms.description: The recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of gedatolisib (administered once weekly for 3 weeks on/1 week off) in combination with darolutamide 600 mg (two 300 mg tablets) orally administered twice daily (equivalent to a total daily dose of 1200 mg on Days 1-28 of each cycle)

primaryEndpoints: Phase 1: Assessment of the safety and tolerability of gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC)
Phase 1: Identification of the recommended Phase 2 dose (RP2D) of gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in mCRPC
Phase 2: Assessment of the antitumor activity of gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in each arm as demonstrated by radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS) by arm
secondaryEndpoints: Assessment of the preliminary efficacy of gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide by arm
